intended_audience: researchers, developers and data/model contributors (documented in README); public browsing of datasets, models and benchmarks
language_observation_notes: English UI observed; language selector labels or non-English metadata are not proof of translated UI pages.

access_restrictions: Public model/dataset dashboard rendered; count zero observed. Contribution sections require login. Read-only browser blocks POST requests; no contribution attempted.
linkage_fact: Tarento, implementing maintainer, describes having designed and delivered the MIT-licensed ULCA data platform for BHASHINI under MeitY. sampling_limitations: Deployment host is ulcacontrib.org (not gov.in); operator attribution relies on the official bhashini.gov.in link. GitHub org ownership not independently verified. The README still points to bhashini.gov.in/ulca, which now serves the generic Bhashini shell. Licence copyright line reads 'ULCA (Project Sunbird)' but ULCA is not one of the Sunbird ED/RC/cQube codebases. Latest dashboard rendered 611 characters; root URL intermittently blank. Data loading and screenshot capture incomplete. This is a specialist public explorer, not a benefits interface.
manual_review_reason: Non-gov.in deployment domain (ulcacontrib.org) attributed through the official Bhashini site link; GitHub org ownership unverified; grade B (vendor case study). Confirm that ULCA is not counted under the in_platforms Sunbird family.

project_name: INCOIS ERDDAP ocean data server (Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services)
license_notes: Explicit license file opened; applies to upstream code, not necessarily local themes or data.
government_operator: Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS), autonomous body under the Ministry of Earth Sciences
intended_audience: researchers and the public (ERDDAP pages for human browsing plus RESTful services); unknown beyond that
language_observation_notes: English UI observed; language selector labels or non-English metadata are not proof of translated UI pages.
repository_reachability: HTTP 200; public repository page visited; license separately checked
access_restrictions: Public dataset discovery and download/graph forms; no login attempted. Default Python TLS validation failed; Chromium with certificate checking enabled rendered the interface.
linkage_fact: The official INCOIS home page (which describes INCOIS as an autonomous body under MoES) lists 'ERDDAP' in its data menu, linking to https://erddap.incois.gov.in/, alongside its Live Access Server. The deployment itself identifies as ERDDAP and its footer shows 'ERDDAP, Version 2.30.0'.
version_evidence: Site footer self-reports ERDDAP 2.30.0; no operator-certified deployed commit or build provenance. Previously checked upstream release v2.30.0 is not proof of byte-for-byte deployment equivalence.
additional_components: INCOIS also runs a Live Access Server (recorded separately as in-incois-las) and a THREDDS/F-TDS server at las.incois.gov.in/thredds/. ERDDAP's built-in machine-translated UI provides the language switcher.
inclusion_rationale: CC0-licensed codebase; government operator (MoES autonomous body on gov.in) names and links the ERDDAP deployment from its official site; public data-search, subsetting and graphing pages with no login; deployed version evidenced.
sampling_limitations: Generic open-source scientific data server (comparable to CKAN-type data-portal families) rather than an India-specific codebase. The incomplete TLS chain may break automated audit tools that do not fetch AIA intermediates. The ODIS catalogue recorded this server as offline in Oct 2025, so availability may vary. Languages other than en are ERDDAP's automatic translations; hi and bn are among ~35 listed options.
manual_review_reason: Confirm (a) that a generic data-server product counts as an entry (like CKAN/NADA/GeoNode do for in_platforms) and (b) that INCOIS, an operational ocean-services autonomous body under MoES, belongs to union rather than the research-institution batch. TLS chain incomplete for non-browser clients.

Language switcher is DSpace's default translation set, not an INFLIBNET localisation claim. Non-English research item titles and language menu labels do not establish observed translated UI pages.
manual_review_reason: Official operator names DSpace as platform; Angular UI selection is corroborated by deployed HTML and UI credits. Exact UI fork/build and version unknown; preserve shared DSpace family.
